cohort: The participants were 73 pregnant women at high-risk of preterm birth, with a final cohort size of 61.
finding: LACTIN-V was found to be safe, highly tolerable, and accepted in pregnancy, with a low rate of preterm birth (<34 weeks) in the cohort compared to a historical cohort.
followup_time: Participants were followed up until delivery.
gest_age: Women were offered LACTIN-V at 14 weeks gestation and followed up at 15, 18, 20, 28, and 36 weeks' gestation; preterm birth was defined as <34 weeks.
